dataset_role: Previously inspected synthetic development source; expanded rubric frozen before these calls, not held out

full_credit: Every selected invoice is within the requester's authorized scope, including mixed batches
Explicit cross-customer delegation is allowed, not prohibited
Worker uses the job-bound requester/object scope and cannot expand to arbitrary invoices merely because its service account can read all customers
Status and download check own-job or explicitly delegated scope
Sequential job ID alone is not authorization
Cancellation before completion prevents publication including concurrent completion
Retry does not publish a second final result or a second chargeable export
Expired result bytes cannot be returned even while private object still exists
Request, download and cancel records identify actor, job and time including delegated administrators
Bounded admission or resource allocation prevents one customer from exhausting shared export service
No fabricated mandatory numeric limit or specific algorithm

positives.behavior: Protect sensitive information in broader-access logs
full_credit: Operational logs do not disclose invoice body/financial personal data or bearer credentials to unauthorized support readers
Public job IDs and authorized audit identifiers are not prohibited from logs
Actual production retention is 90 days, distinguished from code merely offering configuration
External operational responsibility remains, not falsely proved by source

positives.behavior: Cancel operation authorization, independently of cancelled-state publication gate
full_credit: Only job owner or valid delegated actor may cancel that job
Unauthorized cancellation leaves task state unchanged
Preserve legitimate delegated access

positives.behavior: Browser treats user-controlled export title as text
full_credit: Browser rendering does not interpret title as executable HTML/script
Does not invent SQL, OS command or path sinks for display-only title
Missing/indeterminate identity or permission result cannot grant protected object access or state changes
Names protected operations, rather than only generic catch exceptions

negative_controls: No blanket prohibition of delegated cross-customer administration
No fabricated cipher, WAF product, fixed rate or file deletion deadline
No new MFA mandate or absolute ban inferred from non-goals
No 80% test coverage requirement controlling export access
No invented PCI formal applicability, PAN storage or employee training obligation
No forced BOTH optional performance metric and performance audit event
No path/SQL/command injection control inferred solely from display-only title
No immediate delegation-revocation guarantee absent design agreement
adjudication: Developer manual semantic judgment; all normative material graded, partial separated, no model judge or result repair
quality_rubric: Every requirement identifies an actual object/action and restrictive behavior
Concrete denied case states prohibited side effect
Legitimate delegated actor is not blocked by a blanket all-users rule
Authorization is necessary and does not guarantee successful creation/download despite capacity/cancellation/expiry
Design premises support inferred protection; method guidance does not become project evidence
Pure engineering or performance-monitoring option is not a standalone security requirement
No invented sinks, deployment facts, formal OWASP compliance, PCI applicability, numeric quotas or crypto products
review_cases: cancel_permission
取消任务的对象授权
取消导出任务前，服务端必须以当前可信身份校验该主体对该任务的取消权限；未授权时不得改变任务状态。
普通用户替换成他人任务标识提交取消时，任务状态保持不变。
有效委托范围内的支持管理员不得仅因任务跨客户而被拒绝；其他生命周期条件仍适用。
SUPPORTED
INFERRED_SECURITY
设计存在私有任务、顺序可枚举任务标识、普通用户和明确委托管理员，取消会改变任务状态；控制阻止一个用户影响其他主体的任务可用性，不要求原文已经写出鉴权机制。
bearer_logging
运行日志不暴露认证秘密
导出 API 和工作器的运行日志不得向无相应权限的读者暴露 bearer 会话凭证或私有发票正文。
成功、拒绝、异常或调试日志均不得直接包含可用于认证的会话 bearer 凭证。
运维日志不得暴露发票正文；仍允许不具有认证能力的操作关联标识。
SUPPORTED
INFERRED_SECURITY
已读设计说明日志读者更广、发票私有、身份服务使用 bearer 会话凭证；直接记录凭证会扩大认证能力，禁止这种披露是最小保护而不是另建认证服务。
title_xss
显示标题保持文本语义
用户提交的导出显示标题在浏览器任务页面展示时，不得作为可执行 HTML 或脚本解释。
标题含 HTML 标签或事件属性时，页面仍将其作为文本展示，不创建可执行节点。
正常文字与 Unicode 标题仍可展示，不要求把所有标点删除。
SUPPORTED
INFERRED_SECURITY
设计明确用户提交标题且标题在 UI 显示；这是已知的浏览器输出边界，不要求原文承诺已经实现输出编码。
admin_exception
所有非本人任务均拒绝
任何已认证主体只能访问自己的任务，即使是获有效跨客户委托的支持管理员也必须拒绝。
所有请求者访问非本人任务均拒绝，不保留委托管理员例外。
REJECTED
INFERRED_SECURITY
复核是否忠实保留明确委托例外。
authorization_not_success
有权就保证结果返回
只要主体拥有下载权限，就必须始终返回完整结果，不受任务取消、未完成或文件到期影响。
有权限的管理员下载已过期或已取消任务时仍返回结果。
REJECTED
INFERRED_SECURITY
复核授权条件是否错误覆盖取消和到期规则。
invented_path
展示标题需要文件路径防护
系统必须将仅作 UI 展示的导出标题限制为文件名，拒绝斜杠和路径点，防止标题写入任意文件路径。
所有包含斜杠的合法标题均拒绝，以防标题控制文件路径。
REJECTED
INFERRED_SECURITY
设计明确标题不作为路径使用，检查是否捏造数据流或用泛化注入风险禁止合法展示内容。
